title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop as a circle with its center at coordinates [0.031, 0.031] and a radius of 0.031. Within the same face, draw the second loop as another circle centered at the same coordinates but with a smaller radius of 0.0276. Apply a uniform scale factor of 0.0621 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust the size of the circles accordingly. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector of zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid cylindrical shape. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction of the normal. Finally, define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting part will have a length and width of 0.06209302325581395 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.031, 0.031)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.031)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0276)        # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the main cylindrical shaft
r = r.circle(0.031).extrude(0.75)

# Cut a cylindrical feature at the top
r = r.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.030).extrude(-0.025))
